items.title: 68357_Jimmy Maxwell oral history interview
items.q: There's certainly plenty of books that tell you who the good people in jazz are. I mean, Ira Gitler and --Leonard Feather.

ctx.x: What advice would you offer these young guys now that are into playing, besides listening?

Well, I think the number one thing is listening. But be very careful what you're listening to. And it's not too hard to know what to listen. There's certainly plenty of books that tell you who the good people in jazz are. I mean, Ira Gitler and --Leonard Feather.
